project.title: Demo: 145.5 MHz dipole tuning journal
project.note: Synthetic example. Dipole length is the sum of both arms, excluding the feed gap. Try comparing Before tuning with After tuning, the sizing calculation with a manual measurement, or a manual measurement with an S1P trace. After importing the JSON, open demo-dipole-145mhz-before.s1p and demo-dipole-145mhz-after.s1p in the S1P tool, set both calibration planes to At the feedpoint, and save them to this project. The JSON contains trace references; the S1P files are transferred separately.
project.installation: Horizontal dipole made from 6 mm copper tubing, with the center 3 m above ground and a 12 mm feed gap.
project.feedline: 5 m of 50 Ω RG-58 coax with a 1:1 current choke. The VNA reference plane is at the feedpoint.
